output.reason: Evidence shows: (a) for floating rate loans granted for purposes other than business to individuals (with/without co-obligant), the UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges; and (b) in cases other than those mentioned in paragraphs 261(1) and (2), pre-payment charges, if any, shall be as per the UCB’s approved policy. This supports the general idea that the residual clause applies only to cases outside the no-charge rule. However, the evidence does not mention a 5% charge or confirm that the specific “case” at issue falls under the no-charge rule or that a 5% basis is being claimed.
